dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped light-intensity rings distributed across the dorsal-lateral surface, featuring thin perimeters with feathered 2-3 pixel gradient transitions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of solid high-intensity pixel clusters, primarily concentrated at the caudal extremity and lower lateral margins.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent dorsal macro-annuli form an obtuse triangle; lateral keypoints form an irregular chain following the longitudinal axis.
